key_insight: LLM-generated synthetic clinical data closely preserved the original dyslipidemia datasets and supported the same key research signals for secondary cardiovascular prevention.
clinical_relevance: Synthetic data may help researchers share and analyze real-world cardiovascular datasets while reducing privacy and access barriers.
method: Fine-tuned pre-trained LLMs on two real-world Centro Cardiologico Monzino clinical datasets.
Generated synthetic tabular records inside secure local infrastructure to preserve data sovereignty.
Compared synthetic vs real data using fidelity, privacy, and downstream model performance metrics.
evidence_signal: Synthetic datasets showed strong agreement with the source data and reproduced key associations, with only limited distributional differences across a few variables.
watch_item: Some effect sizes were slightly attenuated, so synthetic data should be validated carefully before use for confirmatory analyses.
paper_title: Evaluation of AI-Generated Synthetic Data for Clinical Research in Secondary Cardiovascular Prevention among Dyslipidemia Patients
